_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. Pinned to commit SHAs, not a branch name, as of 0.1.9 -- a branch pin silently picks up whatever that branch's HEAD is at tag-push time, which twice produced a release missing work that had already been committed to the branch but not accounted for when the tag was cut. A SHA pin makes exactly what's bundled explicit and reviewable in this file's own diff. Pinned to pine-lang's merged 0.37.1 (grammar loads from classpath) and beamlynx-ui's merged 0.45.0 (desktop credential persistence -- the whole point of this release) release-PR merge commits -- not yet in a tagged release of either -- switch to a real version tag once they are.
